text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah...
I warmed up thoroughly, but is this my limit?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
Of course, we're seeing results, but..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's not quite something to jump for joy about... I guess you could say.

Air Shakur made a troubled face.
The results were decent at best.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
To reach beyond where we are now...
We need to devise a countermeasure immediately.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Output, control... At any rate, it all comes down to data, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah, don't sweat it too much.
Unlike standard robotics research,
your own physical condition is a factor too.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You get it, right? If you give up here,
you're wasting my time too.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Are you... trying to encourage me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aah? What're you misunderstanding?
I'm just stating a plain fact.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If ya got time to flap your gums,
go home and run another lap.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... I apologize for
dragging you into this again...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I do not mind.
I have decided to support you... for as long as time allows.”

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
But, why are you doing so much...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...It's the same for me.
I have high hopes."

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Thank you.
Well then, it's about time to...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Let's begin the tuning. And we must prepare for the Upgrade Exam in six months as well.
